findings.claim: 10-K 競爭段列出 AI 模型開發商與 AI 產品服務供應商為競爭對手之一，並稱使用者對其他產品「一鍵之遙」
findings.excerpt: We face formidable competition in every aspect of our business, including but not limited to, from: •general purpose search engines and information services; •vertical search engines and e-commerce providers for queries on topics such as those related to travel, jobs, and health, which users may navigate directly to rather than go through Google;

findings.claim: 10-K 風險因素承認新進入者可能提供相似或更好的體驗，消費者可能改變取得資訊的方式，進而降低既有產品效用
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2025 Item 1A Risk Factors
findings.excerpt: As new and existing technologies continue to develop, competitors and new entrants may be able to offer experiences that are, or that are perceived to be, substantially similar to or better than ours, and the consumers may change how they obtain information online, potentially reducing the utility of our existing products and services.

findings.claim: 10-K 指出 AI 加速器（含 GPU 與自研 TPU）供給產能競爭激烈，競爭者若先搶下產能可能使 Alphabet 成本上升、供給受限
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2025 Item 1A Risk Factors
findings.excerpt: industry supply capacity for AI accelerators, including GPUs as well as our custom-built TPUs, is highly competitive and rapidly evolving. If we are unable to negotiate favorable contractual terms or our competitors claim the supply or capacity first, we may face increased costs and supply constraints

competitive_share_entrants.note: 搜尋摘要為模型轉述、無逐字原文，份額數據（StatCounter 全球搜尋約90%、美國 WebFX 87.28%→84.17%；Gemini 網頁流量約27–28% vs ChatGPT 約54%；Synergy 雲端 Google 16%；Anthropic TPU 合約）僅以 clues 列出待程式核原文；多為聚合站，可靠度低。
